description: UI rewiring in backup_screen.dart to the decoupled model, plus the logout-warning confirmation. Set Magic Word no longer backs up and shows a persistent 'takes effect on next backup' status (D1). Back Up Now is disabled when local contacts are empty, steering the user to Restore (D7/D8/D13) — setting a word stays allowed. Restore prompts in three distinct states (D4a), uses the entered word for that decrypt only via restore(overrideMagicWord:) and asks 'remember?' only after a successful restore (D4b), and warns before silently downgrading a magicword cloud file (D11) and before restoring a cloud backup older than local data (D12). Confirm the app_drawer logout warning (D2/forgotten-word). Depends on FEAT-001 (new service signatures/helpers) and FEAT-002 (new l10n keys).
steps: In lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/backup_screen.dart change _applyMagicWord to call `service.setMagicWord(word)` instead of setMagicWordAndRepack. On success: set a persistent status `_statusMessage = l10n.backupSetWordNextBackupHint`, `_statusIsError=false`, refresh `_loadMagicWordState()`; do NOT change `_hasRemoteBackup` or `_lastBackupTime`. On MagicWordValidationFailure show l10n.magicWordLengthError; other failures a generic message. Remove the magicWordSavedRepacking status text and the magicWordRepackFailed branch.

Add `bool _hasLocalContacts = false;` and a `_loadLocalDataState()` that reads ref.read(contactsRepositoryProvider).getSavedContacts() and sets `_hasLocalContacts = list.isNotEmpty`; call it in initState and after a successful restore. Import contacts_repository.dart.

D8/D13 gating: Back Up Now button onPressed is disabled when `_isLoading || !_hasLocalContacts`. When disabled for empty contacts show l10n.backupEmptyDisabledHint near the button; when `_hasRemoteBackup && !_hasLocalContacts` also show l10n.backupRestoreFirstHint and visually prioritize the (already-enabled-on-_hasRemoteBackup) Restore button. The Set/Change Magic Word button stays ENABLED when contacts are empty. Ensure there is NO path from an empty-local state to a cloud overwrite from this screen.

D4a 3-state restore prompt: in _performRestore capture `final hadLocalWord = await ref.read(magicWordServiceProvider).hasMagicWord();` and pass it to _promptMagicWordAndRetryRestore(hadLocalWord). In _askForMagicWord pick the body: `hadLocalWord ? l10n.magicWordRestorePromptBodyWrongWord : l10n.magicWordRestorePromptBodyNoWord`.

D4b no auto-store: rework _promptMagicWordAndRetryRestore so it does NOT call setMagicWord before retrying. Retry via `service.restore(overrideMagicWord: word)`. On SUCCESS show a remember dialog (magicWordRememberTitle/Body/Yes/No); only on 'Remember' call ref.read(magicWordServiceProvider).setMagicWord(word) then _loadMagicWordState(). On wrong word again show l10n.magicWordRestoreWrong and store nothing (remove the old clearMagicWord auto-store cleanup).

D11 downgrade warning: in _performBackup, before calling service.backup, if `await service.cloudIsMagicWordProtected()` is true AND `await ref.read(magicWordServiceProvider).hasMagicWord()` is false, show a confirm dialog (backupDowngradeTitle/backupDowngradeBody); abort the backup if the user cancels.

D12 restore overwrite + stale: the overwrite warning comes from the reworded backupRestoreConfirmBody (FEAT-002). Add a reverse-staleness check in _performRestore: fetch `final cloudTime = await service.cloudBackupModifiedTime();` and `final localTime = await BackupReminderService().lastModifiedAt();` (import backup_reminder_service.dart); if both non-null and cloudTime is before localTime, show backupRestoreStaleTitle/backupRestoreStaleBody (format times with the existing DateFormat pattern) and require confirmation before restoring.

Confirm the app_drawer.dart logout warning still shows drawerLogoutMagicWordNote / drawerLogoutMagicWordNoteStrong via the hasMagicWord branch; keep as-is (strengthen copy only if review finds it weak). Likely no code change.
Run `fvm flutter analyze` and ensure no new issues and no remaining references to setMagicWordAndRepack, magicWordSavedRepacking, or magicWordRepackFailed.
acceptance_criteria: Setting a magic word performs no backup and shows the next-backup status; the screen compiles against the FEAT-001 setMagicWord signature.
Back Up Now is disabled when local contacts are empty and shows the empty/steer hints; Set/Change Magic Word remains enabled; Restore is reachable when a cloud backup exists.
Restore shows the no-word vs wrong-word prompt body correctly, retries with restore(overrideMagicWord:) without persisting, and asks to remember only after a successful restore.

A backup against a magicword cloud file with no local word triggers the downgrade confirmation; restoring a cloud backup older than local data triggers the stale confirmation; the restore confirm body states it overwrites local data.
`fvm flutter analyze` shows no new issues and no references to the removed setMagicWordAndRepack / magicWordSavedRepacking / magicWordRepackFailed symbols.
verification: Run `fvm flutter analyze` from the worktree root — no new issues beyond the documented baseline; no references to removed symbols.
Run `fvm flutter test` — the full suite passes.
findings:
DONE. All UI rewiring in lib/features/settings/presentation/screens/backup_screen.dart; app_drawer.dart logout warning confirmed and left as-is (D2 strong note already shown via the hasMagicWord branch ~line 201 — no change). analyze = documented 5-issue baseline only (firebase_options x2 + 3 zip_import_service_test warnings), NO new issues; no remaining references to setMagicWordAndRepack / magicWordSavedRepacking / magicWordRepackFailed anywhere in lib/.

WHAT CHANGED in backup_screen.dart:
- D1 set-word: _applyMagicWord now calls service.setMagicWord(word) (pure local store). Spinner text uses l10n.backupProcessing; on success shows PERSISTENT status l10n.backupSetWordNextBackupHint and DOES NOT touch _hasRemoteBackup or _lastBackupTime; on MagicWordValidationFailure shows l10n.magicWordLengthError, other failures l10n.commonErrorWithDetail(msg). Snackbar still shows l10n.magicWordSaved (now reworded by FEAT-002). _openSetMagicWordDialog docstring updated to the pure-store semantics.
- D8/D13 gating: added `bool _hasLocalContacts` + `_loadLocalDataState()` (reads contactsRepositoryProvider.getSavedContacts(); contacts-only gate) called in initState and after every successful restore. Back Up Now onPressed is disabled when `_isLoading || !_hasLocalContacts`. Steer hint below the button: shows l10n.backupRestoreFirstHint when a cloud backup exists else l10n.backupEmptyDisabledHint. Set/Change Magic Word button stays ENABLED on empty contacts. Restore button gating unchanged (enabled on _hasRemoteBackup).
- D4a 3-state prompt: _performRestore captures `hadLocalWord` (magicWordServiceProvider.hasMagicWord()) before restore and passes it to _promptMagicWordAndRetryRestore(hadLocalWord) -> _askForMagicWord(hadLocalWord), which picks l10n.magicWordRestorePromptBodyWrongWord vs l10n.magicWordRestorePromptBodyNoWord.
- D4b no auto-store: _promptMagicWordAndRetryRestore retries via service.restore(overrideMagicWord: word) WITHOUT persisting; on success asks a remember dialog (_askRememberMagicWord using magicWordRememberTitle/Body/Yes/No) and only on Remember calls magicWordServiceProvider.setMagicWord(word)+_loadMagicWordState(). On wrong word again shows l10n.magicWordRestoreWrong and stores nothing (old clearMagicWord auto-store cleanup removed).
- D11 downgrade: _performBackup, on the first (non-force) attempt, calls service.cloudIsMagicWordProtected() and, if true AND local hasMagicWord() is false, shows _confirmDowngrade() (backupDowngradeTitle/Body); aborts if cancelled. Not re-checked on the forced retry.
- D12 restore stale/overwrite: overwrite copy comes from FEAT-002's reworded backupRestoreConfirmBody (unchanged dialog). Added reverse-staleness check in _performRestore: fetches service.cloudBackupModifiedTime() and BackupReminderService().lastModifiedAt(); if both non-null and cloudTime.isBefore(localTime) shows _confirmStaleRestore (backupRestoreStaleTitle/backupRestoreStaleBody formatted via DateFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') .toLocal()); aborts if cancelled.
- Imports added: core/services/backup_reminder_service.dart, features/contacts/data/contacts_repository.dart.

L10N NOTE for integration: I did NOT add any l10n keys (FEAT-002 is complete). Where plan item 4 said 'plain saving text' and 'generic failure message' I reused EXISTING generated keys: `backupProcessing` (spinner) and `commonErrorWithDetail(String error)` (generic set-word failure). All other strings use the FEAT-002 keys exactly as named.

TEST FIX (required for 'full suite passes'): FEAT-001's empty-contacts guard broke test/unit/services/drive_migration_test.dart cases (a)/(b)/(c) which seed getSavedContacts->right([]) but drive backup() through the migrate-then-delete path. Seeded ONE UserProfile in that file's setUp (mirrors how FEAT-001 fixed the magicword-mode test) so backup() proceeds past the guard; test intent unchanged. All test/unit tests now pass.

PRE-EXISTING UNRELATED FAILURE (NOT from this feature): `fvm flutter test` (whole tree) reports 1 failure in test/poc/sbcb_interop_vectors_test.dart — a MANUAL interop harness that fail()s by design unless env POC_JOB=emit|verify is set. It is not a backup/magic-word test and I did not touch it. `fvm flutter test test/unit` = All tests passed. If the integration/CI gate runs the whole tree, exclude test/poc or set POC_JOB; it fails identically on the baseline.

ENV NOTE (not committed): same as FEAT-001 — a fresh worktree needs pubspec_overrides.yaml pointing SecBizCard_OCR at the ABSOLUTE sibling path and a one-time build_runner build to materialize gitignored generated code before analyze/test will run.
